sources.title: Qatar PM visits Tehran to pursue mediation efforts
sources.proof_note: Reuters live-file reporting supports the Aug. 27 Tehran visit, the subjects discussed with Abbas Araghchi, the unresolved Iran-Oman finality split, and Mohammad Baqer Qalibaf's 'all-out economic war' rhetoric. The URL was first posted Aug. 26 but this source record dates the supporting updated version to Aug. 27.

sources.title: Shipping traffic through Strait of Hormuz rises slightly, data shows
sources.proof_note: Reports Kpler's visible count of 10 commodity-vessel transits on Wednesday, Aug. 26, up from eight Tuesday but below the 10-day moving average of about 15; transponder-dark traffic remains a counting limitation.

sources.title: Phone Call Between Prime Minister and Minister of Foreign Affairs, Iranian Foreign Minister
sources.proof_note: Primary Qatari statement establishing Doha's pre-visit agenda: support a temporary Iran-Oman corridor and mine-clearing process only as part of a solution guaranteeing freedom of maritime navigation and paving the way to a comprehensive agreement.
